evidence: Fornaroli Theorem 3.7 covers all connected posets at the normal-form level, but not their finite-field counts. Its Theorem 4.20 assumes characteristic different from two and every multiplicative automorphism is inner. Height-two posets with cycles have arbitrary independent edge-rescaling automorphisms, so that restriction can fail.

value.rationale: A complete natural enumerative and conjugacy classification for all finite connected height-two posets over all quadratic finite fields, with a fixed-edge statistic determining exact map counts and poset-duality orbits determining equivalence classes. The characteristic-two and cyclic-poset cases lie outside the hypotheses of prior restricted equivalence results; complete bipartite and crown consequences show structural variation.
